definitions.explanation: A picture made by pasting cut-out paper, photos or other materials onto a surface, or the technique of making one.

examples.japanese: コラージュ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}り{抜|ぬ}いて→切り抜く：06054_kirinuku⟧コラージュにした。
examples.english: I cut out photos from magazines and made them into a collage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧コラージュにして、⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飾|かざ}った→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: I made a collage of photos from the trip and hung it on my bedroom wall.

notes:
From French "collage" (pasting). Also used of photo apps that combine several pictures in one frame.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コラージュ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make a collage
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧コラージュ: photo collage

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{切|き}り{絵|え}→切り絵：33248_kirie⟧: paper cutting
- {貼|は}り{絵|え}: picture made of pasted paper
